pipeline.note: 1.0.0 with the per file media audit applied, and the 38 stems it excludes taken out: 7 mcl_fences textures, whose notice puts textures under GPLv3, and 31 mcl_flowers textures, whose notice has an unscoped GPLv3 line. The other 864 maps are 1.0.0's, byte for byte. 1.0.0 was never catalogued and must not be: it carries those 38. Of the 864, 629 are byte identical to Mineclonia pack 1.3.0's, built from Mineclonia's spec and class; the rest were specced on 2026-10-02 by four Sonnet agents. Judged on offline contact sheets only; not yet on GPU frames or in play.
